name: Stock Shortage Report
query:
SELECT
    b.warehouse AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
    b.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
    i.description AS "Description:Data:150",
    b.actual_qty AS "Available Quantity:Float:120",
    b.ordered_qty AS "Purchase Ordered Quantity:Float:140",
    b.planned_qty AS "Planned Quantity:Float:140",
    b.reserved_qty AS "Sales Order Quantity:Float:140",
    b.reserved_qty_for_production AS "Reserved Quantity for Production:Float:200",
    b.projected_qty AS "Projected Quantity:Float:150",
    'Create Request' AS "Action:Data:160"
FROM
    `tabBin` b
LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem` i ON i.name = b.item_code
LEFT JOIN
    `tabWarehouse` w ON w.name = b.warehouse
WHERE
    b.projected_qty < 0
ORDER BY
    b.projected_qty ASC;
